content: NochBot is Next.js App Router/TypeScript with Node server routes and a synchronous POST /api/crawl contract. Keep Scrapling out of the Next.js runtime and call a versioned service API through a server-only adapter so auth, quotas, chunking, embeddings, MongoDB writes and chat contracts stay in the existing backend. Vercel duration limits vary by plan and Fluid Compute configuration and can be configured with route maxDuration; no reliable budget should be assumed until the actual deployment and plan are confirmed. MEDIUM confidence, official Next.js/Vercel docs and codebase map.
